title: Climbing a Tall Tree
hook: What if you climb a giant tree?
banner:
CLIMB A TALL OAK
SO WHAT NOW?

beats.label: 10 M
beats.line: 10 M: Your breathing speeds up as you climb harder.
beats.idea: Character on a low branch, chest expanding, visible breath.

beats.label: 20 M
beats.line: 20 M: Your heart beats faster, pumping blood to supply oxygen.
beats.idea: Close‑up of a heart beating rapidly, blood rushing.

beats.label: 30 M
beats.line: 30 M: Your head feels light, a faint dizziness from effort.
beats.idea: Character wobbling, stars swirling around head.

beats.label: 40 M
beats.line: 40 M: Your fingertips tingle, gripping bark with sweaty hands.
beats.idea: Ear with sound waves and a pop icon.

beats.label: 50 M
beats.line: 50 M: A cold breeze hits, your skin tingles.

description: A whimsical look at how climbing a tall oak changes your body step by step.
topic: What happens if you climb a tall tree?
